## File: huggingface_dataset-viewer/libs/libviewer/libviewer/cli.py

Prompts

```
['run the cli to query a dataset with offset and limit options', 'run the cli to download and index parquet files from a dataset', 'run the cli to load a dataset from the Hugging Face Hub', 'run the cli to load a dataset from the local cache', 'review the cli command group that initializes dataset loading with revision and metadata options', 'create a Dataset from a Hugging Face Hub repository using from_hub with repo name and token', 'create a Dataset from the local Hugging Face cache using from_cache with optional download flag', 'run a synchronous scan on a Dataset with optional limit, offset, and scan size limit parameters', 'run a synchronous index operation on a Dataset with optional file list and max parallelism settings', 'review the Dataset class that extends PyDataset to read parquet files with page pruning from Hub or cache']
```

Usage

```
{'run_cli_query_dataset': 'run the cli to query a dataset with offset and limit options', 'run_cli_index_parquet': 'run the cli to download and index parquet files from a dataset', 'run_cli_load_from_hub': 'run the cli to load a dataset from the Hugging Face Hub', 'run_cli_load_from_cache': 'run the cli to load a dataset from the local cache', 'review_cli_command_group': 'review the cli command group that initializes dataset loading with revision and metadata options'}
```
